intro: Lesson 44: Paper 2 final technique: three sections in 105 minutes. Answer every question. Show your working. Mark it with the mark scheme and log any errors in your repair list.

questions.q: On a data-response 'describe' question you should:
questions.a: B) Use figures from the resource. Describe asks what the data shows, with figures; explanation is not needed.

questions.q: Name one Paper 2 Section A topic.
questions.a: Urban environments or economic activity and energy

questions.q: Describe this trend: urban population 30% in 1950, 56% in 2020.
questions.a: It rose by 26 percentage points, from 30% to 56%
questions.model: Start value: 30%. End value: 56%. State the direction and the change: rose by 26 percentage points.

questions.q: (b) Describe two effects of climate change on fragile environments.
(c) Explain two human causes of deforestation.
(d) Evaluate the success of sustainable management in a named rainforest region.
questions.a: named region, strategies, strengths and limits, judgement

questions.q: Self-mark with the indicative mark scheme and record two targets.
Rewrite (d) using a second named example.
questions.a: An improved answer with two places
